action: Warm light pours down, streamers and ribbons rise up through it, petals swirl, the light flares brightly once, then softens and fades. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: DIVINE MIRACLE RESURRECTION: a broad shaft of warm dawn sunlight falling from above onto a round patch of ground seen from an elevated three-quarter view, white paper streamers and crimson ribbons rising up through the light, golden motes and petals, the middle empty for a figure. No wings, no feathers, no halo. Palette: shrine white (off-white), crimson, bell gold, warm sunlight yellow, pale rain blue. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Japanese Heian onmyodo and shrine maiden folk magic style: washi paper talismans with fictional brush strokes, folded paper, black and vermilion lacquer, eerie dignified yokai. NOT Thai, NOT Chinese, NOT Indonesian, NOT Slavic, NOT anime: no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no glowing crystals, no lightning, no torii gate, no pentagram or star shape, no taiji, no swastika or manji, no rising sun rays, no runes, no readable kanji or text, no religious symbols, no character, no person, no blood, no gore, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are warm washi off-white, never pure white.
